title: Console onboarding checklist: cohort targeting for feature flag (new orgs + allowlist + percentage rollout)
author: Hannah Rivera
description: Context: we’re rolling out the Guided Onboarding Checklist behind a feature flag and need a predictable way to target cohorts for beta (new orgs by default, optional allowlist, and % rollout). This PR adds server-side cohort targeting logic for the `console.onboarding_checklist` flag and wires it through the Console bootstrap config so the UI can reliably gate the checklist experience without duplicating targeting logic client-side. Targeting rules (precedence order): (1) explicit org override (allowlist/denylist) from config, (2) enable for newly created orgs (org.created_at >= configured `new_orgs_after` timestamp), (3) deterministic percentage rollout based on org_id hashing (`rollout_percent` 0–100), otherwise disabled. Notes: percentage assignment is stable per org across deploys/regions; we do not log org names/emails, only org_id and the evaluated rule id. Added metrics for evaluation outcomes so SRE can validate exposure and detect regressions during beta. Testing: unit tests for hashing stability and precedence, integration test covering config parsing + bootstrap response shape, manual verification in staging by setting `rollout_percent=100` and confirming the checklist renders for an existing org when allowlisted and does not render when denylisted. Rollout: ships disabled by default (rollout_percent=0, new_orgs_after unset) until PM flips config per the beta plan. Related: ENG-23110 (UI shell), ENG-23111 (state model), ENG-23112 (telemetry).
commits: console-api: add cohort targeting evaluator for onboarding_checklist flag
config: support new_orgs_after + allowlist/denylist + rollout_percent for console flags
console-api: expose evaluated flags in bootstrap payload with rule metadata
metrics: add onboarding_flag_evaluation_total counter with outcome labels
tests: hashing stability + precedence order + config parsing coverage
docs: internal comment + runbook snippet for setting beta cohorts
review_conversation: Dylan Brooks: Can we confirm precedence? I want allowlist/denylist to win over percent rollout (especially for support and internal testing). Also please add a short comment in code describing the order so we don’t accidentally change it later.
Hannah Rivera (author): Yep — updated to explicit precedence: override > new_orgs_after > percent > default. Added a docstring on `evaluateOnboardingChecklistFlag()` and a unit test that locks it in.
Chloe Martin: Hashing: please make sure the percent rollout is stable across regions and doesn’t depend on runtime seed. Also, don’t use JS `Math.random()` anywhere in the evaluation path.
Hannah Rivera (author): Confirmed — using `sha256(org_id)` -> first 8 hex chars -> uint32 -> mod 100. Added tests that assert specific org_ids map to expected buckets.

Nadia Rahman: For telemetry/metrics, avoid emitting org slug/name. I’m OK with org_id. Also can we add a metric dimension for which rule matched? We’ll want to confirm new-orgs vs percent are working as intended in beta dashboards.

Hannah Rivera (author): Done. Metric `onboarding_flag_evaluation_total{flag="console.onboarding_checklist", outcome="enabled|disabled", rule="override_allow|override_deny|new_org|percent|default"}`. No org name in logs, only org_id at debug level with sampling.
Marcus Lin: Security/privacy: please double-check logging. I see a debug log includes the full config object; that may contain allowlists. Recommend logging only the resolved rule id and a boolean.
Hannah Rivera (author): Good catch — removed config dump, now logs only `{flag, enabled, rule}` and org_id. Also added a small redaction helper and a linter rule exception is no longer needed.
Dylan Brooks: Looks good. One more: can we ensure `new_orgs_after` parsing is strict ISO-8601 and fails closed (flag disabled) if misconfigured?
Hannah Rivera (author): Updated parsing to strict RFC3339/ISO and returns disabled + emits a config_error metric if parsing fails. Added a test for invalid timestamp.
Marcus Lin: Approved after logging fix.
release_notes: Internal: added cohort targeting for `console.onboarding_checklist` feature flag (new orgs, allowlist/denylist, deterministic percent rollout) to support guided onboarding beta rollouts.
